dedupe_keys.name: dataudveksleren data exchange portal of the danish road directorate 202 road datasets and feeds

description: Dataudveksleren is the data exchange portal of the Danish Road Directorate (Vejdirektoratet), where the directorate and partners publish road data for reuse. The dataset overview read on 2026-09-28 lists 202 published datasets that can be filtered by the EU delegated acts they serve (for example real-time traffic and safety-related traffic information), by service type (WFS, WMS, WMTS, GML, Shapefile, DATEX II event data) and by file type (CSV, JSON, XML, Excel, binary); examples include pavement measurements from the directorate's P79 profilograph vehicle on selected road sections (with an uncertainty of about 10%) and administrative road data from the vejman.dk road management system. Coverage is Denmark's state and municipal roads. Access is free; licences are set per dataset and not shown on the overview. Caveats: datasets vary widely in scope and currency, and some feeds need registration. It supports national road network models, pavement condition and traffic event inputs for flow analysis and hazard exposure studies. Related records: data-denmark-road-weather-feeds is one dataset from this portal.
